sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds We will contribute the net proceeds we receive from the issuance and sale by us of any shares of our common stock to or through the managers and any net proceeds we receive pursuant to any forward sale agreement with the relevant forward purchaser to our Operating Partnership in exchange for common units of partnership interest in our Operating Partnership, or common units. sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt: Risk factors An investment in our common stock involves various risks, and before making a decision to invest in our common stock, prospective investors should carefully consider the matters discussed under the caption entitled “Risk Factors” beginning on page S-6 of this prospectus supplement and in the documents incorporated by reference in this prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus. Conflicts of interest If we enter into a forward sale agreement with any forward purchaser, we expect that such forward purchaser (or its affiliates) will attempt to borrow from third parties and sell, through the relevant forward seller, acting as sales agent for such forward purchaser, shares of our common stock to hedge such forward purchaser’s exposure under such forward sale agreement.
